summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ. Geometry matches the original: large circle centred at O, points A, B, C on it, horizontal chord CB, full small circle centred at P tangent internally at M, and dashed OC, OB and vertical OM. All six labels (A, B, C, O, P, M) are present. Dashed styles were fixed in v2 and the critic scored v2 through v4 at about 0.9. best_version is v2, and v4 is the latest.
